translations.web: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
translations.bsb: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
translations.kjv: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
translations.asv: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
